_comment: Artificers' workshops. Each repairs, buys broken, and takes on consignment any Tower Artifact, at the prices in rarities.json. trains: skill ids this workshop teaches (data/skills.json). sells: what the workshop has for sale, as in shops.json (id, price, max, restock in Pulses; 81 Pulses = a Reckon). Artifacts consigned here also go up for sale, at their full value. Placed in map files with ;npc=x,y <id>. Names are PLACEHOLDERS.

artificer.name: The Artificer's Workshop
artificer.greeting: "Brought me something broken? Let's see it."
